_about: The first run: Qwen 3 1.7B over every scenario, on the DGX-1, chosen by the owner on 2026-09-12.

It is a shakedown, not evidence. Every checker meets real replies and every request shape meets the real server before anything is pre-registered. Its results are never used as confirmatory evidence; the main run collects the 1.7B again.

The 1.7B is also a rung of the Qwen 3 ladder, so two rules follow. No scenario is ever dropped because of how a model did on it: solo ability stays a modelled covariate, as the plan recommends. And the composition sets that test the main claim stay closed on this model: every composition trial with three or more sources, which stage one predicts from pairs alone.

No thinking, because it is the mode every rung of both ladders can run, and because it is the mode the checkers were written for: a reply with no reasoning block in it. The thinking arm runs later, under study-think.

design names how the trials are built: ipb.runner.design turns the scenarios into one two-source conflict each, by a rotation that is a Latin square over source pairs and option pairs. Nothing is random, so the list can be rebuilt from this file alone.
Run it with scripts/run_trials.sh initial-qwen3-1.7b. It appends one JSON line per attempt and skips what is already recorded, so the same command resumes an interrupted run.
